narr: Thunderstorms with heavy rain developed between 2 AM and 4 AM in an area of stronger convergence off Lake Erie in southern Erie County. Automated gauges from weather underground were helpful to get ground truth rainfall reports. Repeated heavy rain resulted in flash flooding in the Southern Tier. Multiple road closures were reported. Areal flooding lingered after the flash flood. The heaviest rain hit the headwaters of the east and west branches of Cazenovia Creek, resulting in very high flows into the early afternoon. The gage EBZN6 quickly rose over 6 feet to around 9 feet in just two hours.
